questions.stem: On a velocity-time graph, a horizontal line at 10 m/s for 5 seconds means the object has travelled:
questions.explanation: The area under the graph is a rectangle: area = velocity x time = 10 m/s x 5 s = 50 m. This is the distance travelled.

questions.stem: On a velocity-time graph, what does a line sloping downward towards zero indicate?
questions.explanation: A line sloping downward on a velocity-time graph shows the velocity is decreasing over time, meaning the object is decelerating (slowing down). The negative gradient represents negative acceleration.
